items.name: Spawn Village and Leaderboard Shoreline
items.landmark: Spawn point, Top Potions List, three leaderboards, Lombart, and Lemin
items.keyContent: Starting village services, material selling, leaderboards, and a nearby shoreline chest
items.relatedFarms: Starter chest route, inventory cleanup, early upgrade planning
items.travelTip: Use the leaderboard platform as the anchor before leaving spawn for the river, bridge, or shop routes.
items.verificationNote: PGG chest guide verifies Lombart, Lemin, the leaderboard platform, and the sandy island chest; BloxInformer materials verifies Lombart in the starting village.

items.name: Alchemy Table and Refine Machine
items.landmark: Alchemy table behind or near the spawn point
items.keyContent: Potion brewing, material selection, spell unlocks, and potion refinement
items.relatedFarms: All material routes feed back into this station
items.travelTip: Return here after a material loop so you can brew before selling rare ingredients by mistake.
items.verificationNote: PGG beginner guide verifies the Alchemy table at spawn and the Refine machine next to it.

items.name: Roger's Equipment Shop
items.landmark: Roger shop menu with wand, wizard hat, and robe tabs
items.keyContent: Wands, wizard hats, robes, early Attack upgrades, and HP gear
items.relatedFarms: Gold farming, boss prep, gear upgrades
items.travelTip: Check wand upgrades before forcing harder enemy routes, because better damage often saves more time than a risky farm.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer wands and wizard hat pages verify Roger's shop menus; local robe, wand, and hat datasets tie multiple equipment rows to Roger's shop.

items.name: Harryint Wanted Board
items.landmark: Wanted board on the right side of spawn
items.keyContent: Repeatable quests for gold and material rewards
items.relatedFarms: Beginner gold farming, monster quests, material gathering
items.travelTip: Pick a quest before starting a combat route so enemy kills also move your gold and material goals.
items.verificationNote: PGG beginner guide verifies Harryint beside the Wanted board on the right side of spawn and names The Bully of the Forest I as an early quest.

items.name: First River Farming Path
items.landmark: River, big rock, tree, and first farming stretch
items.keyContent: Pickaxe Dwarfs, early gathering route, and river rocks chest
items.relatedFarms: Dwarf Emblem, Golden Tooth, early Gold, chest materials
items.travelTip: Run straight from spawn and avoid nearby Pickaxe Dwarfs if you only want the chest or gathering nodes.
items.verificationNote: PGG and GAMES.GG chest guides verify the river rocks chest near the first farming area; BloxInformer monsters verifies Pickaxe Dwarf in Departure Isle forest.

items.name: Traveler Camp and Cauldron
items.landmark: Traveler NPC, Cauldron, tent, bridge, and nearby enemies
items.keyContent: Bridge route, tent chest, route split toward beach and mine-side paths
items.relatedFarms: Knife Goblins, Warhammer Dwarfs, chest materials
items.travelTip: Use the Traveler and Cauldron as the reference point before turning toward the lighthouse, treehouse, or mine cluster.
items.verificationNote: PGG and GAMES.GG both verify the Traveler, Cauldron, bridge, tent, and surrounding Knife Goblin or Warhammer Dwarf route.

items.name: Mine Entrance and Optimistic Miner
items.landmark: Optimistic Miner, wooden boards, plants, and mine entrance
items.keyContent: Mine chest, miner hint, cave route, and nearby Pickaxe Dwarfs
items.relatedFarms: Chest materials, early dwarf route, mine cluster sweep
items.travelTip: Enter from the boarded mine entrance after the first Pickaxe Dwarf platform instead of trying to force the thorny upper path.
items.verificationNote: PGG chest guide verifies the Optimistic Miner and mine entrance route; the chest dataset reuses the matching local screenshot.

items.name: Secret Mine Cave
items.landmark: Right side of the back wall inside the mine
items.keyContent: Hidden cave extension and secret chest
items.relatedFarms: Chest materials, hidden-route checking
items.travelTip: Open this immediately after the normal mine chest so you do not backtrack into the mine later.
items.verificationNote: PGG and GAMES.GG verify the illusion wall behind the mine cave.

items.name: Mine Mountain Top
items.landmark: Rocks, thorny vines, and upper mine platform
items.keyContent: Top-of-mine chest and high route practice
items.relatedFarms: Chest materials, movement practice
items.travelTip: Use the rocks on the left side of the mine entrance, then follow the thorny vines to the upper platform.
items.verificationNote: PGG and GAMES.GG verify the top-of-mine chest route.

items.name: Goblin Camp Hidden Platform
items.landmark: Bridge rocks, brown pine trees, Knife Goblins, campfire, and rear platform
items.keyContent: Hidden platform chest and bridge-side goblin route
items.relatedFarms: Knife Goblins, chest materials, early hidden-route sweep
items.travelTip: Check the rocks on the right side of the bridge before crossing all the way to the Traveler camp.
items.verificationNote: PGG verifies the hidden platform near spawn, Knife Goblins, and campfire; GAMES.GG lists the same goblin campfire route with different ordering.

items.name: Departure Isle Beach and Portal
items.landmark: Beach route, sea edge, portal area, and Apprentice Broom spot
items.keyContent: Apprentice Broom purchase spot, Warhammer Dwarf and Archer Goblin routes, path toward lighthouse
items.relatedFarms: Flame Crest, Copper Earring, Goblin Finger, Goblin Bone, Dwarf Emblem
items.travelTip: Treat the beach as a connector between mid enemy farming, the lighthouse route, and later travel upgrades.
items.verificationNote: Beebom brooms guide verifies Apprentice Broom under the portal at Departure Island beach; BloxInformer monsters places Warhammer Dwarf and Archer Goblin in Departure Isle beach routes.

items.name: Lighthouse Island
items.landmark: Lighthouse, sea, small island, and mountain behind the island
items.keyContent: Lighthouse chest, beach navigation, route anchor for Dwarf King and treehouse checks
items.relatedFarms: Chest materials, Archer Goblins, Warhammer Dwarfs, boss-route travel
items.travelTip: Use the Traveler and Cauldron as a starting reference, then run left past Archer Goblins and Warhammer Dwarfs until the sea opens up.
items.verificationNote: PGG and GAMES.GG verify the lighthouse island chest and route from the Traveler/Cauldron side.

items.name: Dwarf King Cave and Throne
items.landmark: Dwarf King spawn, hammer wall, chained stone, and cave area
items.keyContent: Boss farming, throne-area chest, Furnace Core route, Flame Crest and Copper Earring drops
items.relatedFarms: Gold, Flame Crest, Copper Earring, Furnace Core
items.travelTip: Farm Dwarf King only after your wand, HP gear, potions, and movement are steady enough for repeat clears.
items.verificationNote: PGG verifies the Dwarf King chest landmark near the hammer wall; BloxInformer monsters verifies Dwarf King in Departure Isle Dwarf King Cave.

items.name: Treehouse Branch and Platform
items.landmark: Huge tree, rope climb, treehouse door, railing, and charred branch
items.keyContent: Treehouse chest and Ember Staff Wand purchase route
items.relatedFarms: Chest materials, late Departure Isle wand upgrade
items.travelTip: Tilt the camera upward near the lighthouse route to spot the huge tree before climbing.
items.verificationNote: PGG verifies the treehouse platform chest; PGG and BloxInformer wands sources connect Ember Staff to the treehouse branch route, with some left/right direction conflict.

items.name: Starting Village Waterfall Cave
items.landmark: Waterfall cave near the starting village
items.keyContent: Ice Star Wand purchase spot
items.relatedFarms: Gold saving, cooldown-focused wand upgrade
items.travelTip: Save the waterfall route for when 20,000 Gold is realistic, because the Ice Star Wand is a late Departure Isle purchase.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer wands verifies Ice Star Wand inside the waterfall next to the starting village; other source wording disagrees on exact direction, so the row avoids left/right claims.

items.name: Main Sea of Oblivion Base
items.landmark: Main Sea of Oblivion area, Alchemy station, and Lava Broom spot
items.keyContent: New Mainland hub, Lava Broom purchase spot, Sea of Oblivion material route start
items.relatedFarms: Fern, Sulphur Lumps, Volcanic Rock, orc materials, New Mainland potion targets
items.travelTip: Use the Sea of Oblivion base as the reset point before branching to the enchanting table, lava island, volcano, or lava waterfall.
items.verificationNote: Roblox page title verifies New Mainland context; Beebom brooms guide verifies Lava Broom right of Alchemy in Sea of Oblivion.

items.name: Enchanting Table Island
items.landmark: Small island near the main Sea of Oblivion
items.keyContent: Wand enchantment table and Enchanted Stone spending
items.relatedFarms: Enchanted Stones, wand enchantment rolls, Sea of Oblivion power upgrades
items.travelTip: Farm a stack of Enchanted Stones before interacting, because each enchantment roll consumes one stone and the result is random.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG enchantments guide verifies the enchanting table on a small island near the main Sea of Oblivion. Image intentionally withheld until a clean enchanting-table screenshot without guide callout arrows is available.

items.name: Lava Island and Enchanted Sword Ferns
items.landmark: Lava island with Enchanted Sword Ferns
items.keyContent: Enchanted Stone farming and lava-island material route
items.relatedFarms: Enchanted Stones, Fern, Volcanic Rock, Sulphur Lumps
items.travelTip: Check whether your build can handle the tougher fern enemies before turning this into a long loop.
items.verificationNote: GAMES.GG enchantments guide verifies Enchanted Sword Ferns scattered across the lava island; local materials data supports Sea of Oblivion gathering routes but does not place every node.

items.name: Volcano Summit
items.landmark: Top of the Volcano
items.keyContent: Ember Wand purchase spot
items.relatedFarms: 50,000 Gold saving, Sea of Oblivion wand progression
items.travelTip: Treat the volcano route as a late upgrade stop, not an early detour, because Ember Wand costs far more than Departure Isle shop wands.
items.verificationNote: Local wands dataset records Ember Wand at the top of the Volcano from BloxInformer New Mainland data; exact movement path still needs in-game capture. Image intentionally withheld until a clean volcano summit screenshot without guide callout boxes is available.

items.name: Lava Waterfall Base
items.landmark: Fiery lava waterfall next to the Sea of Oblivion base
items.keyContent: Lava Wizard Hat purchase or pickup route
items.relatedFarms: 10,000 Gold saving, lava resistance, New Mainland survival
items.travelTip: Check this route when lava resistance matters, because the Lava Wizard Hat is the only currently tracked hat with that utility.
items.verificationNote: Local wizard hats dataset records Lava Wizard Hat behind the fiery lava waterfall next to the base from BloxInformer live New Mainland data; older sources do not include the New Mainland hat.
